title: Verity role outcome (provider structured final output)
description: The role-outcome shape a provider's structured final message (e.g. Codex --output-last-message) must satisfy before it is trusted. Normalized by the provider driver into contracts/agent-result.md v1; schema-invalid output fails closed to infra_error. Validation is enforced by the hand-rolled validator in verity/bin/lib/agents/result-contract.cjs (zero-dependency policy) — this file is the published contract artifact that code must match. Artifact entries are relative repo paths: absolute paths and any '..' traversal segment are rejected.
